INT. FAMILY HOUSE - MORNING

AMAR
I promised I would deliver the letter before noon.

Amar folds the letter and puts it inside his cloth bag. His younger sister Meera watches him from the doorway.

MEERA
You have been saying that since sunrise.

EXT. MARKET ROAD - AFTERNOON

Amar walks through the crowded road with the cloth bag over his shoulder. Meera catches up with him.

MEERA
The bus has already left. Tell me what is really in that letter.

AMAR
It is an apology. Father wrote it, but he could not bring himself to send it.

INT. SMALL SHOP - EVENING

SHOPKEEPER
You came a long way for a piece of paper.

Amar removes the letter from his cloth bag and places it on the counter.

AMAR
The paper is small. What it needs to repair is not.
